title: Growth OS full application certification catalogue

scope.statement: This is a test catalogue, not a claim that tests ran or the app is certified.
scope.module_count_note: 25 seeded business workflows; expand current route/control/operation registry via CAP-01 and CAP-02 before full coverage. Route inventory is separate.

flag_definitions.requires_credentials: Needs legitimate dedicated test identity/provider access; absence means BLOCKED, never assume or invent credentials.
flag_definitions.external_effect: May modify a destination outside Growth OS, e.g. provider publish/send/CRM write; use only explicitly authorized test target.
flag_definitions.spend: May consume paid inference/render/provider quota; verify operation-specific spending limit before execution.
flag_definitions.destructive: May replace/delete/revoke infrastructure/data; restricted to disposable staging fixtures with explicit authorization.
flag_definitions.verification_mode: LIVE_RUNTIME means exercise the actual deployed application/gateway/DB/worker path; controlled fixture input is allowed, mocked provider success is not live provider proof.
flag_definitions.provider_mode: REAL requires actual provider operation; CONTROLLED_FAILURE may inject a documented failure against the real gateway; NOT_APPLICABLE needs no provider.

full_pass: Every required scenario has an independent reviewed PASS observation for the exact candidate and required environment.
Each enabled provider/tool operation has real happy-path, failure, permission/revocation and durable-result proof. A connector-level test does not certify all operations.
All visible modules have all five module scenarios completed; no NOT_RUN/BLOCKED/FAIL/WAIVED required scenario.
All three client workflows pass; PDF/PPTX/XLSX independently open/render/reconcile.
Staging security/recovery evidence and production identity/routing/configuration smoke are both recorded; staging PASS alone is not production certification.
No open P0/P1 client-impact defect in the claimed full scope; every complete external action has a receipt.
Changes to source/deployment/config/schema/policies/provider-adapter versions invalidate affected observations; rerun impacted scenarios on final candidate.
CAP-01 and CAP-02 inventories are complete and all route/control/operation parameter bindings have passing observations; one sample operation never certifies an entire connector or module.
no_go: Any cross-client or Secret Vault disclosure, unauthorized action, duplicate external effect or success-on-failure.
Required credentials/provider approval missing or required operation fails; record BLOCKED/FAIL and do not call full scope certified.
Required evidence absent, unreadable or mismatched SHA/environment; tests not executed remain NOT_RUN.
Unknown provider outcome not reconciled; unapproved spend or effect required to complete testing.
Destructive/recovery test cannot be safely confined to disposable staging.
certification_rules.scope_change: Only an explicit founder scope decision may exclude a required operation. Preserve original results, version the reduced scope and label its certificate accordingly; a waiver is not a test pass.
certification_rules.fixtures: Fixture/mock tests may establish unit or controlled-failure behavior. They cannot replace required real-provider, real-database or production configuration proof.
certification_rules.certification_label: Use FULL_SCOPE_CERTIFIED only after full_pass rules; otherwise NOT_CERTIFIED or explicitly named narrower-scope certification.

config_fingerprint.description: Nonsecret hash of relevant config, policies and adapter versions; never raw secret values.
